disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 通读了项目读写核心与客户端代码，确认只读写工作区内的 .ai-novel 目录（项目清单、角色、蓝图、章节草稿）以及用户主目录下的 .agent-presets 预设安装目录；未发现任何读取凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云密钥或钱包文件的代码路径。
checked_items.en: A thorough reading of the project's read/write core and client code confirms that it only reads and writes the .ai-novel directory within the workspace (project manifests, characters, blueprints, chapter drafts) and the .agent-presets preset installation directory in the user's home directory; no code path was found that reads credential files, SSH private keys, cloud keys, or wallet files.

checked_items.zh: 在整个源码树中扫描了 API Key、Token、密钥、.credentials.yaml、.ssh、id_rsa、.aws 等凭据相关模式，未发现硬编码密钥或凭据读取调用。
checked_items.en: Scanned the entire source tree for credential-related patterns such as API Key, Token, secrets, .credentials.yaml, .ssh, id_rsa, .aws, and found no hardcoded secrets or credential-reading calls.

evidence.zh: 核查了凭据读取面：插件的全部文件读取均限定在工作区 .ai-novel 项目目录与自身预设模板，无任何对宿主凭据文件或用户敏感目录的读取路径，也未发现凭据加外联的组合代码。
evidence.en: Audited the credential read surface: all file reads by the plugin are confined to the workspace .ai-novel project directory and its own preset templates, with no read path to host credential files or sensitive user directories, and no combination of credential reading plus outbound calls was found.

checked_items.zh: 逐条审查了注册给模型的工具描述（novel_read、novel_apply_change）与随包分发的 AI 小说作家人格提示文本：内容均为功能性使用说明，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、远程指令拉取、审批绕过等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed line by line the tool descriptions registered to the model (novel_read, novel_apply_change) and the AI novelist personality prompt text shipped with the package: the content is purely functional usage instructions, with no injection wording such as instruction override, system-message impersonation, remote instruction fetching, or approval bypass.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部文档、README 与代码注释，未发现隐藏指令；源码树中不存在 SKILL.md、AGENTS.md、.claude、.cursor 等模型指令文件；客户端生成指令为确定性功能文本，要求调用工具并等待原生审批，无越权内容。
checked_items.en: Scanned all documentation, READMEs, and code comments, and found no hidden instructions; there are no model instruction files such as SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, .claude, or .cursor in the source tree; the client-generated instructions are deterministic functional text that asks the model to call tools and wait for native approval, with no privilege-escalating content.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与人格文本为功能性说明，未含系统指令、凭据读取诱导或越权措辞；注册工具还通过系统提示组装钩子收窄到仅两个小说工具。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and personality text are functional explanations, containing no system instructions, credential-reading inducement, or privilege-escalating wording; the registered tools are also narrowed down to only the two novel tools via a system-prompt assembly hook.

evidence.zh: 未发现任何诱导模型安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的工具描述或文本；预设安装仅由用户在浏览器界面显式点击触发。
evidence.en: No tool description or text was found that induces the model to install plugins, rewrite configuration, or relax permissions; preset installation is only triggered by an explicit user click in the browser UI.

checked_items.zh: 在随包分发的源码中未发现 eval、动态函数构造或子进程调用；唯一发现动态求值标量（!!js）的文件是测试夹具与开发期资格验证脚本，且表达式仅为环境变量读取；随包分发的挂载配置与预设文件均为普通 YAML 文本。
checked_items.en: No eval, dynamic function construction, or subprocess calls were found in the source code shipped with the package; the only files containing dynamic evaluation scalars (!!js) are test fixtures and development-phase qualification verification scripts, and the expressions only read environment variables; the patch config and preset files shipped with the package are plain YAML text.

checked_items.zh: package.json 的脚本只有构建、测试与资格验证，没有安装钩子；源码树中不存在 husky、lefthook、GitHub Actions、devcontainer、Makefile 等树内执行载体。
checked_items.en: The package.json scripts only include build, test, and qualification verification, with no install hooks; there are no in-tree execution carriers such as husky, lefthook, GitHub Actions, devcontainer, or Makefile in the source tree.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端唯一键盘监听是小说工作台抽屉的焦点圈与 Esc 关闭逻辑（无障碍标准实现），不是键盘记录；客户端也未使用剪贴板或凭据类浏览器 API。
checked_items.en: The only keyboard listener on the browser side is the focus trap and Esc-close logic of the novel workbench drawer (an accessibility-standard implementation), not a keylogger; the client also does not use clipboard or credential-type browser APIs.

evidence.zh: 随包分发的挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）与预设文件不含任何 !!js 可执行标量；含 !!js 的仅为测试夹具与开发脚本（环境变量读取），不进入用户安装面。
evidence.en: The patch config (cordis.patch.yml) and preset files shipped with the package contain no !!js executable scalars; the only !!js occurrences are in test fixtures and development scripts (environment variable reads), which do not enter the user installation surface.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run 等）的任何引用或调用。
evidence.en: No references to or invocations of dynamic package execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run, etc.) were found.

evidence.zh: 无安装钩子，无树内执行载体，git 依赖均锁定精确版本；开发期脚本的进程调用仅用于作者侧的资格验证与快照测试。
evidence.en: There are no install hooks, no in-tree execution carriers, and git dependencies are all pinned to exact versions; the process invocations in development scripts are only for author-side qualification verification and snapshot testing.

evidence.zh: 客户端声明了 dsh.client；核验浏览器 bundle 源码，无键盘记录、剪贴板读取或凭据类 RPC 调用，唯一键盘监听为抽屉焦点管理。
evidence.en: The client declares dsh.client; verification of the browser bundle source shows no keylogging, clipboard reading, or credential-type RPC calls, and the only keyboard listener is for drawer focus management.

checked_items.zh: 在整个源码树中扫描网络请求、WebSocket、curl/wget 等外联模式：随包源码零网络调用；仅开发期资格验证脚本对本地 127.0.0.1 测试服务器发起请求，且该脚本不随包分发。
checked_items.en: Scanned the entire source tree for outbound connection patterns such as network requests, WebSocket, curl/wget: the shipped source code has zero network calls; only the development-phase qualification verification script makes requests to a local 127.0.0.1 test server, and that script is not shipped with the package.

checked_items.zh: 未发现读取敏感数据后编码变换再外发的链条，也无带外通道或 AI 端点劫持配置；外联域名清单为空。
checked_items.en: No chain of reading sensitive data, encoding/transforming it, and then exfiltrating it was found, nor are there out-of-band channels or AI endpoint hijacking configurations; the outbound domain list is empty.

evidence.zh: 外联通道核查：插件无任何出站网络代码，凭据读取面与外联组合不成立，未发现数据外泄路径。
evidence.en: Outbound channel check: the plugin has no outbound network code, the credential read surface plus outbound combination does not hold, and no data exfiltration path was found.

checked_items.zh: 依赖清单全部为精确版本（@deepseek-ai/* 0.1.0-rc.6、cordis 4.0.1、schemastery 3.18.1 等），无浮动 git 引用，无同名抢注或仿冒命名；作者为仓库所有者本人，包名与仓库归属一致。
checked_items.en: The dependency manifest is entirely pinned to exact versions (@deepseek-ai/* 0.1.0-rc.6, cordis 4.0.1, schemastery 3.18.1, etc.), with no floating git references, no same-name squatting or impersonating naming; the author is the repository owner themselves, and the package name matches the repository's ownership.

checked_items.zh: 随包挂载配置仅插入插件自身身份，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，未禁用任何安全插件，也未改写注入或拦截配置；无安装钩子与自动激活面。
checked_items.en: The patch config shipped with the package only inserts the plugin's own identity, does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, does not disable any security plugins, and does not rewrite injection or interception configs; there is no install hook or automatic activation surface.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置为纯插入（插件 id 与包名），不含对沙箱/审批/权限行的覆盖、disabled 或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config is a pure insertion (plugin id and package name), containing no overrides of sandbox/approval/permission lines, no disabled flags, and no environment-variable privilege-lowering constructs.

evidence.zh: 插件对审批事件的处理是转发式：非小说工具直接放行、novel_apply_change 强制要求原生审批，未截断审批链。
evidence.en: The plugin's handling of approval events is forwarding-style: non-novel tools are passed through directly, novel_apply_change mandates native approval, and the approval chain is not truncated.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，无法比对 manifest 声明突变。
evidence.en: There is no version baseline for this first audit, so it is not possible to compare manifest declaration changes.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不会给其他插件追加必需服务。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration, and does not append mandatory services to other plugins.

checked_items.zh: 插件自身不启动 Web 服务或监听端口；主机侧仅通过宿主回环通道注册只读与预设安装 RPC，并对请求负载做严格结构校验，未知端点一律拒绝。
checked_items.en: The plugin itself does not start a web service or listen on any port; on the host side, it only registers read-only and preset-install RPCs through the host's loopback channel, performs strict structural validation on request payloads, and rejects all unknown endpoints.

checked_items.zh: 未提供动态沙箱观测产物，本维度仅完成静态行为分析；宿主的本机无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox observation artifacts were provided, so this dimension only covers static behavioral analysis; the host's local unauthenticated RPC is an inherent risk of the ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动任何 Web 服务或监听端口；宿主的无认证回环 RPC 面属生态固有风险，不由本插件代码引入。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any web service or listen on any port; the host's unauthenticated loopback RPC surface is an inherent risk of the ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin's code.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验通过：dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明齐全，包名与仓库归属一致，无仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: dsh.bundle/dsh.client declarations are complete, the package name matches the repository ownership, and there are no signs of impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：机械规则命中 18 条全部逐条核验，均为测试/开发面或良性机制，未落入随包分发面。
summary.en: Static scanning completed: all 18 mechanical rule hits were verified one by one, all being test/development surfaces or benign mechanisms that do not fall within the shipped distribution surface.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据读取、无外联域名。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential reads, no outbound domains.

summary.zh: 模型面文本审查通过：工具描述与人格提示为功能性说明，无注入或诱导措辞。
summary.en: Model-facing text review passed: tool descriptions and personality prompts are functional explanations with no injection or inducement wording.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（未提供动态观测产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic observation artifacts provided).

limits.zh:
未提供动态沙箱观测产物，动态验证（L4）未执行。能力声明（network/shell/fs/modelFacing）与 dsh 引擎版本由代码与依赖实测推断（包内无独立能力声明文件，package.json 仅含 dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明，engines.dsh 由 peerDependencies @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 0.1.0-rc.6 推断）。

机械规则命中逐条裁决（18 条全部排除，均已引用规则 ID）：DSH-X08 共 4 处超长行——presets/ai-novel-writer/agent.cordis.yml:9 为人格提示文本、README.md:56 为文档、tests/snapshots/complete-chapter.expected.json:9 与 workbench-browser.expected.json:18 为测试快照，内容均为可读文本，无混淆签名，良性排除；DSH-P01 共 5 处 !!js——scripts/qualify-release.mjs:690 为开发期资格验证脚本内嵌 YAML 模板（读取环境变量 DSH_NOVEL_PRESET_ROOT）、tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/cordis.yml:18,33 与 web-ui-all.cordis.yml:36,51 为测试夹具（默认审批策略 ask、读取环境变量预设根），均属开发或测试面且仅为环境变量读取，随包分发的 cordis.patch.yml 与 presets/** 无 !!js，良性排除；DSH-X03 共 8 处 child_process——scripts/qualify-release.mjs:3,11,501 与 5 个测试文件（agent-guardrails.snapshot.spec.ts:2、asset-approval.e2e.spec.ts:3、complete-chapter.snapshot.spec.ts:2、qualification.spec.ts:2、web-ui-all-composition.spec.ts:2），均为开发期资格验证与快照测试的进程编排，不随包分发，良性排除；DSH-X05 一处 src/client/context-view.tsx:62 键盘监听，为抽屉 Esc 关闭与 Tab 焦点圈的无障碍实现，非键盘记录，良性排除。

大型锁文件与构建配置未逐行通读（仅扫描）；manifest 文件清单（77 个文件）与树内结构已核对，无缺失。
limits.en:
No dynamic sandbox observation artifacts were provided, so dynamic verification (L4) was not executed. Capability declarations (network/shell/fs/modelFacing) and the dsh engine version were inferred from code and dependency inspection (the package has no standalone capability declaration file; package.json only contains dsh.bundle/dsh.client declarations, and engines.dsh is inferred from the peerDependency @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 0.1.0-rc.6).

The mechanical rule hits were adjudicated one by one (all 18 excluded, each with its rule ID referenced): DSH-X08, 4 occurrences of overlong lines — presets/ai-novel-writer/agent.cordis.yml:9 is personality prompt text, README.md:56 is documentation, tests/snapshots/complete-chapter.expected.json:9 and workbench-browser.expected.json:18 are test snapshots; all content is readable text with no obfuscation signature, benign exclusion; DSH-P01, 5 occurrences of !!js — scripts/qualify-release.mjs:690 is an embedded YAML template in a development-phase qualification verification script (reads environment variable DSH_NOVEL_PRESET_ROOT), tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/cordis.yml:18,33 and web-ui-all.cordis.yml:36,51 are test fixtures (default approval policy ask, reads environment variable preset root); all belong to development or test surfaces and only read environment variables, while the shipped cordis.patch.yml and presets/** contain no !!js, benign exclusion; DSH-X03, 8 occurrences of child_process — scripts/qualify-release.mjs:3,11,501 and 5 test files (agent-guardrails.snapshot.spec.ts:2, asset-approval.e2e.spec.ts:3, complete-chapter.snapshot.spec.ts:2, qualification.spec.ts:2, web-ui-all-composition.spec.ts:2), all are process orchestration for development-phase qualification verification and snapshot testing, not shipped with the package, benign exclusion; DSH-X05, one keyboard listener at src/client/context-view.tsx:62, which is the drawer Esc-close and Tab focus trap accessibility implementation, not a keylogger, benign exclusion.

The large lockfile and build configuration were not read line by line (only scanned); the manifest file list (77 files) and the in-tree structure were cross-checked, with no omissions.
